name: Panner Disease
definition: Self-limited osteochondrosis of the capitellum occurring in younger children, typically under 10 years, causing lateral elbow pain and stiffness.

investigations.principle: Radiographs usually demonstrate capitellar changes; MRI is selective.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, occult injury, postoperative or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent atypical symptoms require reassessment because prognosis is usually favorable.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kurpara Asthi developmental phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Self-limited osteochondrosis of the capitellum occurring in younger children, typically under 10 years, causing lateral elbow pain and stiffness.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, respiratory distress, progressive neurological deficit, open injury, severe deformity, infection or other listed red flags.
